**English** · [Français](#français)

Windows build: unzip anywhere and run. `ffmpeg` is not included in the archive (see the README: the program downloads it, SHA-256 checked). There is also an optional installer that includes `ffmpeg.exe`. Linux and macOS are frozen: version 2.1.1 is the last one with their archives, which stay available under the GPL-3.0-or-later on the earlier releases.

| System | Archive |
|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 (64-bit) | `ShaderToMP4-<version>-win64.zip` |
| Windows 10/11 (64-bit), installer, ffmpeg included, not code-signed | `ShaderToMP4-<version>-win64-setup.exe` |

SHA-256 sums: `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Documentation: [README](https://github.com/ap3demak-rgb/ShaderToMP4#readme) · Website: https://ap3demak-rgb.github.io/ShaderToMP4
